summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HRMS application with both backend API and frontend UI testing. All core functionalities are working correctly including two-tier authentication, role-based access control, and all major modules.
passed_tests: Admin login via Admin tab (admin@hrms.com / admin123)
Employee login via Employee tab (employee@hrms.com / emp123)
Admin and Employee login tab toggle functionality
Cross-login prevention (admin cannot login via employee tab and vice versa)
Admin dashboard shows all stat cards (6 cards) and quick actions (4 actions)
Admin sidebar shows all modules: Dashboard, Employees, Departments, Hierarchy, Attendance, Leave, Payroll, Reimbursements, Recruitment, Performance
Employee sidebar properly restricts admin-only modules (4/4 restricted)
Admin can view Employees page with employee table (2 employees found)
Admin can manage permissions for employees (8 permission toggles working)
Admin can view Hierarchy page with org chart (2 hierarchy nodes)
Admin can assign reporting relationships via hierarchy button
Leave application page works for employees (form opens correctly)
Reimbursement submission page works for employees (form opens correctly)
Attendance clock in/out works for employees (both buttons functional)
All backend APIs return correct status codes (13/13 tests passed)
Dashboard stats API returns all required fields
Authentication endpoints work correctly with proper role validation
Employee permissions are properly enforced in UI
